title: Plans to Manage Numbers of Private Hire Car Driver's Vocational Licences Issued
what_it_is: Plans to Manage Numbers of Private Hire Car Driver's Vocational Licences Issued

sections.label: PHC Driver's Vocational Licences
sections.summary: The number of PHC Driver's Vocational Licences has been roughly maintained for the past few years, with no plans to constrain the total number of drivers.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: The number of PHC Driver’s Vocational Licences has continued to be roughly maintained at the same level for the past few years.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: There are no plans at the moment for us to constrain the total number of drivers.

sections.label: Taxi and point-to-point population
sections.summary: The taxi or point-to-point population has increased from 28,000 ten years ago to around 70,000 today, with about 400,000 total rides a day, and there is no intention to curtail the number.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: The taxi or the point-to-point population has increased from 28,000 10 years ago, to roughly around 70,000 today.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: But at the same time, I think if you look at the number of total rides, it is about 400,000 a day, that is substantial and it complements our public transport provision, which is still going to be our main focus for our transport policy.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: So, we have no intention at the moment to curtail the number, but I think the number has stabilised over time.

sections.label: Transient employment and labour pool
sections.summary: Transient employment lets people earn income between jobs, and while numbers have not been intentionally restricted, the market decides whether they enter the bus industry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: There are people who are also in transient employment and this is a good way for them to come in and continue to earn an income, maybe when they are in between jobs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: And so, to that end, we have not intentionally tried to restrict the numbers But as the Member has pointed out, this is a important pool of labour.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: Certainly, I would appreciate if some of them go into the bus industry, help us address the constraint that we have for public buses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: But we have to leave it to the market and to let them decide.
